_source: Device object copied from the attributes example in Tailscale's API docs, https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale/blob/v1.72.0/publicapi/device.md#attributes (now https://tailscale.com/api); default field set (no enabledRoutes / advertisedRoutes / clientConnectivity, per publicapi/tailnet.md#list-tailnet-devices). Wrapped in { devices: [...] } and connectedToControl added, as the official client reads it: https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale-client-go-v2/blob/main/devices.go
